Concepts

The platform groups work into projects and runs.

Projects

A project holds configuration and access rules.

Limits

Each account may create up to ten projects.

Runs

A run executes one pipeline. Logs stay available for thirty days.

example run start --project demo

Limits

A run stops after six hours. See the limits page.
